title: Two Halves are More than One: Phase-wise Velocity Distillation for Fast and High-Quality Image Generation
title_zh: 两个半模型胜过一个：分阶段速度蒸馏，实现快速高质量图像生成

paragraphs.en: Recent diffusion-based image generation backbones have grown substantially in scale, making the network inference cost increase rapidly. While diffusion distillation techniques can reduce the number of inference steps, high-quality image generation within a single full-backbone-forward compute budget remains challenging. Existing one-step methods typically allocate this budget to a single evaluation of a monolithic student. However, approximating the heterogeneous coarse-to-fine transport with a single monolithic mapping is difficult and often leads to over-smoothed outputs. To address this issue, we propose P hase-wise V elocity D istillation ( PVD ), which partitions the generation timeline into a coarse and a fine phase, and models the transition within each phase via the average velocity. A dedicated half-sized expert is assigned to each phase, decoupling structural composition from detail refinement while keeping the cumulative computation equivalent to one full-backbone forward pass. We show that the use of two half-sized phase-specific experts outperforms a single full-size monolithic student. On class-conditional image generation, PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 . On more complex text-to-image (T2I) tasks, PVD-distilled models (Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image) produce results competitive with their multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods. Moreover, across the evaluated T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10–50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76–48.36% compared to the corresponding teachers. Source code and distilled models are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/PVD .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的扩散模型基础图像生成架构规模显著增大，导致网络推理成本迅速上升。 尽管扩散蒸馏技术能够减少推理步数，但在单次完整主干网络前向计算预算内生成高质量图像仍然具有挑战性。 现有的一步方法通常将这一预算分配给一个单一的整体学生模型的一次评估。 然而，用单一的整体映射来近似异质的粗到细传输过程十分困难，且常常导致过度平滑的输出。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了分阶段速度蒸馏（PVD）方法，该方法将生成时间线划分为粗阶段和细阶段，并通过平均速度对每个阶段内的过渡进行建模。 每个阶段都分配一个专用的半尺寸专家模型，从而将结构构图与细节优化解耦，同时保持累计计算量与一次完整主干网络前向传播相当。 我们的实验表明，使用两个半尺寸的阶段专用专家模型的效果优于单个全尺寸的整体学生模型。 在条件图像生成任务中，PVD 在 ImageNet 256×256 上实现了 1.48 的 FID 值。 在更复杂的文本到图像（T2I）任务中，经过 PVD 蒸馏的模型（Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image）生成的结果可与多步教师模型相媲美，并显著优于先前的蒸馏方法。 此外，在所有评估的 T2I 基础模型中，与对应的教师模型相比，PVD 将活跃参数减少了 49.10%–50.89%，峰值 VRAM 使用量减少了 45.76%–48.36%。 源代码和蒸馏模型可在 https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/PVD 获取。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have substantially advanced image synthesis and can generate high-quality images with diverse content [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . However, their generation process follows an iterative coarse-to-fine trajectory [ 1 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] , which typically requires tens to hundreds of costly full-backbone-forward passes to transform noise into desired images. This computational bottleneck poses a significant barrier to interactive applications in the real world [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] .

paragraphs.en: To accelerate generative inference, extensive efforts have been dedicated to diffusion distillation by reducing multi-step sampling into a few or even a single forward pass. Existing methods can be broadly grouped into two paradigms (see Fig. 2 , left and middle). Trajectory-based methods train the student to replicate the teacher’s generative trajectory by progressively halving the sampling steps [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] , enforcing self-consistency along the trajectory [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , or directly regressing the average velocity over a temporal interval [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] . Distribution-based methods instead align the student’s output distribution with that of the teacher or the data by adversarial supervision [ 25 , 26 ] or score/divergence-based distribution matching [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了加速生成推理，研究人员投入了大量精力进行扩散蒸馏，通过将多步采样简化为少数几次甚至单次前向传播。 现有方法大致可分为两种范式（参见图 2 的左侧和中间部分）。 基于轨迹的方法训练学生模型以复现教师的生成轨迹，具体方式包括逐步将采样步数减半 [14, 15, 16]、强制轨迹沿线的自一致性 [17, 18, 19]，或直接回归时间区间内的平均速度 [20, 21, 22, 23, 24]。 而基于分布的方法则通过对抗性监督 [25, 26] 或基于分数/散度的分布匹配 [27, 28, 29, 30]，使学生的输出分布与教师模型或数据的分布对齐。

paragraphs.en: Despite the remarkable progress of the above-mentioned two paradigms, they share a common architectural assumption: a single, monolithic student is able to accomplish the entire generative mapping from pure noise to images with rich details, regardless of whether the inference unrolls into a few steps or a single forward pass. This assumption conflicts with the intrinsically dynamic nature of the diffusion process, in which early stages establish global low-frequency structure while later stages add high-frequency details [ 1 , 31 , 8 , 10 , 32 ] . When the inference budget is relaxed to multiple steps, the same set of parameters can revisit the trajectory several times and partially compensate for this mismatch; under a strict single full-backbone-forward budget, however, the monolithic student must resolve coarse layout and fine details simultaneously in one forward pass, exceeding the capacity of a single compact model. Since a noisy state may admit multiple plausible clean targets, the model tends to regress toward their conditional average to minimize the training loss [ 20 ] , leading to over-smoothed outputs with diminished fine details and even generation collapse in one-step sampling, especially for complex Text-to-Image (T2I) tasks [ 33 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管上述两种范式取得了显著进展，但它们共享一个共同的架构假设：单个、一体化的学生智能体能够完成从纯噪声到富含细节图像的完整生成映射，无论推理过程是展开为几个步骤，还是仅通过一次前向传播。 这一假设与扩散过程内在的动态特性相冲突：在该过程中，早期阶段建立全局的低频结构，而后期阶段则添加高频细节 [ 1 , 31 , 8 , 10 , 32 ] 。 当推理预算放宽至多个步骤时，同一组参数可以多次重走这条轨迹，从而部分弥补这种不匹配；然而，在严格的单次完整主干前向传播预算下，一体化学生智能体必须在一次前向传播中同时解决粗略布局和精细细节，这超出了单个紧凑模型的能力范围。 由于一个含噪声的状态可能对应多个合理的干净目标，模型倾向于向其条件平均值回归以最小化训练损失 [ 20 ] ，这会导致输出过度平滑、精细细节减少，甚至在单步采样中出现生成崩溃，尤其是在复杂的文本到图像（T2I）任务中 [ 33 ] 。

paragraphs.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose P hase-wise V elocity D istillation ( PVD ), a phase-decomposed distillation framework for high-quality image generation under a single full-backbone-forward compute budget (see Fig. 2 , right). PVD partitions the generation trajectory into a structural phase and a refinement phase, and assigns a dedicated half-sized expert to each phase to align the model capacity with the coarse-to-fine nature of diffusion while keeping the cumulative inference cost within a single forward pass of the teacher. Each expert is supervised to approximate the localized average velocity over its phase, replacing the global noise-to-data jump with two shorter-horizon transport objectives. For more complex T2I tasks, we further introduce phase-specific discriminators, one focusing on global structural consistency and the other on fine-grained details, to compensate for the over-smoothing tendency of L 2 L_{2} velocity regression. The two experts are able to share a common half-sized backbone and are instantiated as lightweight Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules, substantially reducing memory overhead. In summary, our contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We introduce Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD) , a trajectory decomposition distillation framework that partitions the diffusion process into temporally phase-wise average-velocity transports under a single full-backbone-forward budget constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种分阶段速度蒸馏（Phase-wise Velocity Distillation，PVD）方法，这是一种轨迹分解蒸馏框架，它在一个完整的“主干-前向”预算约束下，将扩散过程划分为按时间分阶段的平均速度传输。

paragraphs.en: We train Phase-wise Experts via localized mean-velocity objectives to align model capacity with the coarse-to-fine dynamics of diffusion, improving generation quality without increasing the compute budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过局部平均速度目标训练分阶段专家，使模型容量与扩散过程的从粗到细的动态过程相匹配，从而在不增加计算预算的情况下提升生成质量。

paragraphs.en: PVD achieves superior performance on both class-conditional image (C2I) and T2I generation to existing distillation methods. On C2I, it reaches FID 1.48 on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 ; on T2I, distilled Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, and Qwen-Image models demonstrate competitive performance on GenEval, TIIF-Bench, and Qwen-Image-Bench, etc., while significantly reducing active parameters and peak VRAM relative to the corresponding teachers.

paragraphs.en: Denoising Diffusion and Flow Matching. Early diffusion models, represented by DDPM [ 1 ] and DDIM [ 34 ] , employ iterative denoising for high-fidelity generation, which enjoys stable optimization but is tied to a fixed reverse diffusion path of tens to hundreds of small denoising steps, making it difficult to apply to large-scale models. Flow matching [ 35 ] and rectified flow [ 3 ] revisit this problem from the perspective of continuous transportation. Instead of committing to a fixed diffusion path, flow matching learns velocity fields by simulation-free regression over conditional probability paths, while rectified flow favors straighter trajectories to regress with coarse ODE solvers. With transformer backbones [ 36 , 4 ] , these paradigms can be well scaled to large T2I models, such as FLUX [ 5 , 37 ] , Qwen-Image [ 6 ] , and Z-Image [ 7 ] . Nevertheless, their inference still relies on multi-step integration, and even rectified training paths can yield curved marginal trajectories in practice [ 20 , 21 ] . Such an expensive inference cost motivates few-step distillation techniques.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散与流匹配。 早期的扩散模型，以 DDPM [ 1 ] 和 DDIM [ 34 ] 为代表，采用迭代去噪方式实现高保真生成。这种方法虽然具有稳定的优化特性，但受限于固定且包含数十至数百个小型去噪步骤的逆向扩散路径，因此难以应用于大规模模型。 流匹配 [ 35 ] 和修正流 [ 3 ] 从连续传输的角度重新审视了这一问题。 与采用固定扩散路径不同，流匹配通过无模拟的条件概率路径回归来学习速度场，而修正流则倾向于使用更直的轨迹，以便能用粗略的常微分方程求解器进行回归。 借助 Transformer 主干网络 [ 36 , 4 ] ，这些方法可以很好地扩展至大型 T2I 模型，例如 FLUX [ 5 , 37 ] 、Qwen-Image [ 6 ] 和 Z-Image [ 7 ] 。 然而，它们的推理过程仍然依赖多步积分，而且即便是修正后的训练路径，在实际应用中也可能产生弯曲的边缘轨迹 [ 20 , 21 ] 。 如此高昂的推理成本推动了少步蒸馏技术的发展。

paragraphs.en: Few-step Distillation. Existing few-step distillation methods can be broadly categorized into trajectory-based and distribution-based paradigms. The former aims to preserve teacher dynamics while reducing solver steps. For example, progressive distillation [ 14 , 15 ] recursively compresses the teacher sampler, while InstaFlow [ 16 ] shortens the transport path through reflow. Consistency methods, including CM [ 17 ] , iCM [ 18 ] , sCM [ 19 ] , and Hyper-SD [ 38 ] , replace explicit solver imitation with consistency constraints. More recent methods, including Shortcut Models [ 20 ] , MeanFlow [ 21 ] , improved MeanFlow (iMF) [ 22 ] , α \alpha -Flow [ 23 ] , FACM [ 24 ] , ArcFlow [ 39 ] , and TDM [ 40 ] , explicitly model long-horizon transport. The distribution-based paradigm relaxes path fidelity to match the student output distribution to the teacher or data distribution. ADD [ 25 ] and LADD [ 26 ] use adversarial supervision to improve perceptual sharpness. DMD [ 27 ] , DMD2 [ 28 ] , and their variants [ 29 , 30 ] use score- or divergence-based objectives to align the student distribution. Recent extensions further refine this family: Phased DMD [ 41 ] introduces subinterval-wise progressive distribution matching, while Decoupled DMD [ 42 ] uses CFG augmentation as the main distillation engine and distribution matching as a stabilizing regularizer. By relaxing path-level supervision in favor of distribution alignment, distribution-based approaches tend to improve perceptual sharpness, at the cost of weaker trajectory fidelity under aggressively reduced budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 少步蒸馏。 现有的少步蒸馏方法大致可分为基于轨迹和基于分布的两种范式。 前者旨在保留教师模型的动力学特性，同时减少求解器的步数。 例如，渐进式蒸馏 [ 14 , 15 ] 通过递归压缩教师采样器实现目标，而 InstaFlow [ 16 ] 则通过重流缩短传输路径。 一致性方法（包括 CM [ 17 ]、iCM [ 18 ]、sCM [ 19 ] 和 Hyper-SD [ 38 ]）用一致性约束替代了对求解器的显式模仿。 更近期的方法（包括 Shortcut Models [ 20 ]、MeanFlow [ 21 ]、改进的 MeanFlow (iMF) [ 22 ]、α \alpha -Flow [ 23 ]、FACM [ 24 ]、ArcFlow [ 39 ] 和 TDM [ 40 ]）则显式建模了长时程传输过程。 基于分布的范式通过放宽路径保真度，使学生的输出分布与教师模型或数据分布相匹配。 ADD [ 25 ] 和 LADD [ 26 ] 利用对抗性监督来提升感知清晰度。 DMD [ 27 ]、DMD2 [ 28 ] 及其变体 [ 29 , 30 ] 使用基于得分或散度的目标函数来对齐学生分布。 近期的扩展方法进一步改进了这一系列：Phased DMD [ 41 ] 引入了按子区间渐进匹配分布的机制，而 Decoupled DMD [ 42 ] 则将 CFG 增强作为主要蒸馏引擎，将分布匹配用作稳定正则化项。 基于分布的方法通过放宽路径级监督、转而关注分布对齐，通常能提升感知清晰度，但在预算大幅削减时会导致轨迹保真度下降。

paragraphs.en: Phase-wise Generation. The diffusion process is phase-structured: early denoising steps produce global layout and semantics, while later steps refine textures and high-frequency details [ 1 , 8 ] . It has been shown [ 31 , 32 ] that the early navigation stage is guided by multiple data modes and the later refinement stage is dominated by the closest samples. Based on these observations, eDiff-I [ 43 ] uses an ensemble of experts for different denoising regimes; Wan2.2 [ 10 ] adopts an SNR-based two-expert MoE that switches from a high-noise expert to a low-noise expert; Glance [ 44 ] employs a lightweight variant through SNR-guided slow and fast LoRA experts; and TimeStep Master [ 45 ] combines interval-specific LoRA experts through time-dependent routing. On the other hand, Hierarchical Distillation [ 9 ] employs trajectory distillation for structure generation and distribution refinement for details synthesis, while Phased DMD [ 41 ] introduces subinterval-wise progressive refinement within DMD-style distillation. While reducing the gap between coarse semantic planning and fine-detail rendering, these methods operate in the few-step regime, and do not work under a strict single full-backbone-forward compute budget.
paragraphs.zh: 分阶段生成。 扩散过程具有阶段结构：早期的去噪步骤生成全局布局和语义，而后期步骤则优化纹理和高频细节 [ 1 , 8 ] 。 已有研究证明 [ 31 , 32 ]，早期导航阶段由多种数据模式引导，而后期优化阶段则由最接近的样本主导。 基于这些观察结果，eDiff-I [ 43 ] 为不同的去噪阶段使用了专家集成；Wan2.2 [ 10 ] 采用了一种基于 SNR 的双专家 MoE 结构，从高噪声专家切换到低噪声专家；Glance [ 44 ] 通过 SNR 引导的慢速和快速 LoRA 专家使用了一种轻量级变体；而 TimeStep Master [ 45 ] 则通过时间依赖的路由将特定时间间隔的 LoRA 专家组合在一起。 另一方面，Hierarchical Distillation [ 9 ] 采用轨迹蒸馏进行结构生成，并通过分布优化来合成细节，而 Phased DMD [ 41 ] 则在 DMD 风格的蒸馏中引入了子区间渐进式优化。 尽管这些方法缩小了粗略语义规划与精细细节渲染之间的差距，但它们都在少步操作模式下运行，无法在严格的单次完整正向计算预算下工作。

paragraphs.en: Due to the highly nonlinear geometry of global diffusion trajectories, high-fidelity generation under constrained inference budgets often encounters unexpected errors and oversmoothed results. To address this issue, we propose Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD) , which decomposes the generative trajectory into localized phases to distill their average velocity fields . For each local phase, a lightweight, phase-specific expert is used to accomplish the transport. As shown in Fig. 3 , PVD employs a three-stage training paradigm. First, a half-sized backbone extracted from the teacher is fine-tuned via flow matching to initialize the student. Second, we partition the time horizon into distinct phases, and use lightweight, phase-specific experts to learn localized average velocities. Third, for the more difficult T2I tasks, discriminators are trained to provide adversarial refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 由于全局扩散轨迹的高度非线性几何结构，在受约束的推理预算下实现高保真生成时，常常会遇到意外错误和过度平滑的结果。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了分阶段速度蒸馏（PVD）方法，该方法将生成轨迹分解为多个局部阶段，以蒸馏出各阶段的平均速度场。 对于每个局部阶段，都会使用一个轻量化的、针对该阶段的专家模型来完成传输任务。 如图 3 所示，PVD 采用了一种三阶段训练范式。 首先，通过从教师模型中提取的半尺寸主干网络，利用流匹配方法对其进行微调，从而初始化学生模型。 其次，我们将时间范围划分为多个独立阶段，并使用轻量化的、针对各阶段的专家模型来学习局部平均速度。 第三，对于更具挑战性的文本到图像生成任务，我们会训练判别器以提供对抗性优化。

paragraphs.en: While L 2 L_{2} velocity matching ( Eq. 7 ) provides teacher-anchored supervision, it may regress to the mean and yield perceptually oversmoothed outputs. We therefore introduce phase-wise discriminators for complementary adversarial supervision in T2I tasks. Unlike traditional GANs that learn global mappings, our discriminators, denoted by D ω i D_{\omega_{i}} , act as localized perceptual enhancers operating strictly within their respective phases ℐ i \mathcal{I}_{i} . paragraphs.en: Experimental Settings. We evaluate PVD on both class-conditional image (C2I) generation and text-to-image (T2I) generation. For C2I, we follow the ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 setting used in recent one-step studies such as FACM [ 24 ] , and report FID-50K and Inception Score (IS). For T2I, we distill students from SD3.5-Medium [ 4 ] , FLUX.1-dev [ 5 ] , and Qwen-Image [ 6 ] , and evaluate them on various evaluation benchmarks, including GenEval [ 47 ] , DPG-Bench [ 48 ] , WISE [ 49 ] , TIIF-Bench miniset [ 50 ] , Qwen-Image-Bench (QI-Bench) [ 51 ] , together with Aesthetic Score using Aesthetic Predictor V2.5 [ 52 ] , PickScore [ 53 ] and ImageReward [ 54 ] . For the computational cost, we report Normalized Sampling FLOPs, defined as N flops = F sample / F ref N_{\mathrm{flops}}=F_{\mathrm{sample}}/F_{\mathrm{ref}} , where F sample F_{\mathrm{sample}} sums the accumulated FLOPs of the distilled student model to generate one image, including guidance branches, and F ref F_{\mathrm{ref}} denotes the FLOPs of one forward pass of the corresponding teacher backbone under the same input setting.

paragraphs.en: Training Configuration. For C2I, we adopt the same teacher configuration as FACM [ 24 ] , and perform full-parameter distillation on our phase-wise experts, which have a total of 676M parameters. Optimization is executed using AdamW with a batch size of 1024 1024 , a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . For T2I tasks, the SD3.5-Medium configuration undergoes full-parameter phase-wise finetuning, with 1.11B parameters per phase. For FLUX.1-dev [ 5 ] , we utilize rank- 64 64 LoRA experts, pairing a shared 5.82B backbone with two 0.16B LoRA experts (6.14B in total). For Qwen-Image [ 6 ] , we use rank-32 LoRA experts, pairing a shared 10.25B backbone with two 0.15B LoRA experts (10.55B in total). The experts for different temporal phases are trained independently. Detailed training hyperparameters are summarized in Tab. 6 of Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: Ablation Studies. We conduct ablations with a 133M-parameter model along three axes: (i) the temporal partition ( t 1 , 1 − t 1 ) (t_{1},1{-}t_{1}) , (ii) the overlap between adjacent training intervals, and (iii) expert composition, comparing ordered phase-specific experts with two evaluations of a shared student. As shown in Tab. 2 , the asymmetric [ 0.4 , 0.6 ] [0.4,0.6] split achieves the best FID and IS, suggesting that the two phases play unequal roles: the early expert establishes global structure from high-noise inputs, whereas the late expert requires a broader interval to refine local details. Reducing the overlap improves performance, while full overlap substantially degrades both metrics, indicating that excessive sharing weakens phase specialization. Finally, replacing the ordered experts with two evaluations of a shared student degrades FID from 12.89 to 26.62 and IS from 126.70 to 77.12. Thus, repeated computation alone cannot replace phase-specific capacity allocation. Based on these results, we use the [ 0.4 , 0.6 ] [0.4,0.6] split, zero overlap, and early-to-late expert composition by default.
paragraphs.zh: 消融研究。 我们使用一个包含 133M 个参数的模型，沿三个维度进行消融实验：(i) 时间划分 ( t 1 , 1 − t 1 ) (t_{1},1{-}t_{1})，(ii) 相邻训练区间之间的重叠程度，以及 (iii) 专家组成，即比较有序的各阶段专用专家与对共享学生模型进行两次评估的方案。 如表 2 所示，非对称的 [ 0.4 , 0.6 ] [0.4,0.6] 划分实现了最佳的 FID 和 IS 值，这表明两个阶段的作用并不均等：早期专家从高噪声输入中建立全局结构，而晚期专家则需要更宽的时间区间来优化局部细节。 减少重叠程度可提升性能，而完全重叠则显著降低两项指标，表明过度共享会削弱各阶段的专门化能力。 最后，用对共享学生模型进行两次评估的方案取代有序的专用专家，会使 FID 从 12.89 降至 26.62，IS 从 126.70 降至 77.12。 因此，仅靠重复计算无法替代各阶段专用的容量分配。 基于这些结果，我们默认采用 [ 0.4 , 0.6 ] [0.4,0.6] 的划分、零重叠以及从早期到晚期专家的组成方式。

paragraphs.en: Across the three backbone groups, PVD consistently achieves most of the best results on various evaluation dimensions. For prompt alignment, such as GenEval and TIIF-Bench, and general generation capability, such as Qwen-Image-Bench, monolithic models have to jointly handle semantic grounding, layout composition, and visual synthesis within a single forward process. In contrast, PVD accomplishes this task with half-sized phase-wise experts: the early expert focuses on semantic grounding and global layout construction, while the late expert refines perceptual details and high-frequency visual patterns. This divide-and-conquer design also improves perceptual quality. On aesthetic and perceptual metrics such as Aesthetic Score, PickScore, and ImageReward, conventional single-forward models produce over-smoothed results, whereas PVD allows the second expert to enhance local details after the global structure has been established. As a result, PVD achieves a better balance between structural accuracy and perceptual sharpness.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个主干模型组中，PVD 在各种评估维度上始终取得多数最佳结果。 对于提示对齐任务（如 GenEval 和 TIIF-Bench）以及通用生成能力（如 Qwen-Image-Bench），整体式模型必须在单次前向传播过程中同时处理语义锚定、布局构图和视觉合成。 相比之下，PVD 通过半尺寸的分阶段专家完成这一任务：早期专家专注于语义锚定和全局布局构建，而后期专家则优化感知细节和高频视觉模式。 这种分而治之的设计也提升了感知质量。 在美学与感知指标（如 Aesthetic Score、PickScore 和 ImageReward）上，传统单次前向传播模型生成的结果过于平滑，而 PVD 允许第二个专家在全局结构建立后增强局部细节。 因此，PVD 在结构准确性与感知清晰度之间实现了更优的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Ablation Studies. We ablate PVD along three axes: capacity allocation, adversarial refinement, and expert composition. Detailed results are provided in Appendix I . Under compute-controlled comparisons, the compact phase-wise experts outperform a monolithic full-size student even when the latter costs twice the computation. In addition, adversarial refinement provides a complementary quality gain, and expert reuse and order swaps further reveal that the learned mappings are directional and non-interchangeable. Together, these results indicate that PVD’s gains come from allocating capacity to ordered phase-specific experts rather than simply increasing the number of evaluations.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD) for high-quality image generation within a single full-backbone-forward compute budget. Rather than assigning the heterogeneous coarse-to-fine transport to one monolithic student, PVD partitions the generation timeline into coarse and fine phases, models each transition through its average velocity, and assigns a dedicated half-sized expert to each phase. This phase-wise allocation separates structural composition from detail refinement while keeping the cumulative computation equivalent to one full-backbone evaluation. Experiments on both class-conditional and text-to-image generation show that two ordered phase-specific experts outperform a single full-size monolithic student under comparable computation. PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 . When applied to Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, and Qwen-Image, it remains competitive with the corresponding multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods. Across these T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10–50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76–48.36%. These results indicate that PVD is an effective way to improve the quality–efficiency trade-off of few-step image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了“分阶段速度蒸馏”（Phase-wise Velocity Distillation, PVD）方法，能够在单次完整的“背骨-前向”计算预算内生成高质量图像。 与将异构的粗到细传输任务分配给一个单一的整体学生模型不同，PVD 将生成时间线划分为粗阶段和细阶段，通过每个阶段的平均速度来建模转换过程，并为每个阶段分配一个专用的半尺寸专家模型。 这种分阶段分配方式将结构构图与细节优化分离开来，同时保持了累计计算量与一次完整的“背骨”评估相当。 在条件分类生成和文本到图像生成任务上的实验表明，在计算量相当的情况下，两个有序的、针对特定阶段的专家模型比单个全尺寸的整体学生模型表现更优。 PVD 在 ImageNet 256 × 256 数据集上实现了 1.48 的 FID 值。 当应用于 Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev 和 Qwen-Image 时，PVD 仍然能与对应的多步骤教师模型保持竞争力，并显著优于先前的蒸馏方法。 在这些文本到图像（T2I）背骨模型中，PVD 将活跃参数减少了 49.10%–50.89%，峰值显存（VRAM）减少了 45.76%–48.36%。 这些结果表明，PVD 是一种有效改善少步图像生成中质量与效率权衡的方法。

sents.zh: 这种分阶段分配方式将结构构图与细节优化分离开来，同时保持了累计计算量与一次完整的“背骨”评估相当。

sents.en: Experiments on both class-conditional and text-to-image generation show that two ordered phase-specific experts outperform a single full-size monolithic student under comparable computation.
sents.zh: 在条件分类生成和文本到图像生成任务上的实验表明，在计算量相当的情况下，两个有序的、针对特定阶段的专家模型比单个全尺寸的整体学生模型表现更优。

sents.en: PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 .
sents.zh: PVD 在 ImageNet 256 × 256 数据集上实现了 1.48 的 FID 值。

sents.en: When applied to Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, and Qwen-Image, it remains competitive with the corresponding multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods.
sents.zh: 当应用于 Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev 和 Qwen-Image 时，PVD 仍然能与对应的多步骤教师模型保持竞争力，并显著优于先前的蒸馏方法。

sents.en: Across these T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10–50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76–48.36%.
sents.zh: 在这些文本到图像（T2I）背骨模型中，PVD 将活跃参数减少了 49.10%–50.89%，峰值显存（VRAM）减少了 45.76%–48.36%。

sents.en: These results indicate that PVD is an effective way to improve the quality–efficiency trade-off of few-step image generation.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，PVD 是一种有效改善少步图像生成中质量与效率权衡的方法。

paragraphs.en: Limitations . For the sake of simplicity, we empirically split the teacher backbone into two half-sized experts, yet the optimal number of experts and more effective partitioning strategies can be further investigated. Although effective, PVD can still fail for cases such as dense object counting and uncommon spatial relations, which are also challenging cases for the teacher backbones. Representative examples of failure cases are provided in Appendix J .
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 为简化起见，我们在实证中将教师骨干网络拆分为两个尺寸减半的专家模型，但专家的优化数量以及更有效的划分策略仍有待进一步研究。 尽管 PVD 方法有效，但在密集物体计数和罕见空间关系等场景下仍可能失效，而这些场景对于教师骨干网络而言同样具有挑战性。 典型失败案例的示例见附录 J。

paragraphs.en: We further compare PVD with closely related methods that instantiate different forms of temporal specialization, phase-wise distillation, or average-velocity modeling. As summarized in Tab. 5 , we compare these methods from the following aspects: (i) whether the training objective is explicitly restricted to predefined temporal phases, (ii) whether different phases are associated with distinct trainable parameters, (iii) whether average velocity is used as the primary transport target, (iv) whether inference explicitly factorizes the full transport into a sequential composition of phase-specific operators, and (v) how the resulting design allocates active model capacity and cumulative sampling computation. This decomposition separates temporal specialization itself from the compute-constrained transport factorization targeted by PVD.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将 PVD 与密切相关的方法进行了比较，这些方法实现了不同形式的时序专业化、分阶段蒸馏或平均速度建模。 如表 5 所示，我们从以下几个方面对这些方法进行了比较：(i) 训练目标是否明确限制在预定义的时序阶段；(ii) 不同阶段是否与不同的可训练参数相关联；(iii) 是否将平均速度作为主要的传输目标；(iv) 推理过程是否明确地将完整传输分解为各阶段特定算子的序列组合；以及 (v) 最终的设计如何分配活跃模型容量和累计采样计算量。 这种分解将时序专业化本身与 PVD 所针对的计算受限的传输分解区分开来。

paragraphs.en: MeanFlow [ 21 ] learns interval-conditioned average velocities with a single shared model and supports few-step generation. However, its standard few-step inference allocates the shared model capacity to a single global noise-to-data transport, rather than explicitly decomposing inference into a sequence of phase-specific operators. Hierarchical Distillation [ 9 ] uses MeanFlow-based trajectory distillation to initialize a single-step student and subsequently refines the same generator with distribution-level objectives; thus, the hierarchy is primarily realized through the training procedure rather than through temporally distinct inference operators.
paragraphs.zh: MeanFlow [ 21 ] 使用单一共享模型学习区间条件化的平均速度，并支持少步生成。 然而，其标准的少步推理将共享模型的容量分配给单一的全局噪声到数据的传输过程，而不是明确地将推理分解为一系列特定于阶段的算子。 分层蒸馏 [ 9 ] 使用基于 MeanFlow 的轨迹蒸馏来初始化一个单步学生模型，随后通过分布级目标对同一生成器进行优化；因此，这种层次结构主要通过训练过程实现，而非通过时间上分离的推理算子。

paragraphs.en: TimeStep Master [ 45 ] and Glance [ 44 ] introduce timestep- or phase-specific lightweight parameters, while retaining the underlying backbone during each iterative denoising evaluation. These methods therefore specialize parameters across temporal regimes, but do not explicitly replace the global transport with a sequence of compact phase-local average-velocity operators under a one-backbone-equivalent cumulative compute budget. Phased DMD [ 41 ] directly decomposes generation into subinterval-wise generators and sequential intermediate transports, but its few-step inference configuration requires multiple generator evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: TimeStep Master [ 45 ] 和 Glance [ 44 ] 引入了与时间步或阶段相关的轻量级参数，同时在每次迭代去噪评估中保留了底层的骨干结构。 因此，这些方法在不同时间区间上对参数进行了专门设计，但并未明确地将全局传输替换为一系列紧凑的局部平均速度算子，且未在一倍骨干等效的累积计算预算下实现这一点。 Phased DMD [ 41 ] 直接将生成过程分解为子区间生成器和顺序的中间传输步骤，但其少步推理配置需要多次执行生成器评估。

paragraphs.en: PVD differs from these methods in that it integrates phase-restricted average-velocity learning, distinct compact phase experts, and explicit sequential transport composition. Instead of assigning the full model capacity to a single long-horizon mapping, PVD temporally factorizes the transport and reallocates the same aggregate sampling-compute budget across shorter phase-specific mappings. Consequently, both the transport horizon and the active capacity per evaluation are factorized, while the cumulative sampling cost remains approximately equal to one full-backbone forward pass.
paragraphs.zh: PVD 与这些方法的不同之处在于，它整合了相位受限的平均速度学习、独立的紧凑相位专家以及显式的序列传输组合。 PVD 并未将全部模型容量分配给单个长时程映射，而是对传输过程进行时间上的分解，并将相同的总采样计算预算重新分配到多个较短的特定相位映射中。 因此，传输时程和每次评估的有效容量都实现了分解，而累计采样成本仍大致等于一次完整的骨干网络前向传播。

paragraphs.en: MeanFlow learns an interval-conditioned average velocity using one network shared across all sampled interval pairs. Under one-step generation, this network must model the complete noise-to-data transport in a single query. Pu et al. [ 33 ] show that this setting is substantially harder for T2I than for C2I: their MeanFlow adaptation collapses to pure noise after 1 step, retains visible noise and artifacts after 2 steps, and produces high-fidelity images after 4 steps. Increasing the number of steps can therefore improve fidelity, but it repeatedly invokes the same global capacity. PVD instead retains MeanFlow distillation while factorizing the transport into early and late phases handled by compact phase-specific experts.
paragraphs.zh: MeanFlow 使用一个共享于所有采样区间对的单一网络，学习一种以区间为条件的平均速度。 在一步生成中，该网络必须通过单次查询建模完整的噪声到数据的转换过程。Pu 等人 [ 33 ] 指出，这种设置对于 T2I 而言比 C2I 困难得多：他们的 MeanFlow 适配在 1 步后便退化为纯噪声，在 2 步后仍保留可见的噪声和伪影，而在 4 步后才能生成高保真图像。 因此，增加步数可以提升保真度，但会重复调用相同的全局容量。 PVD 则保留了 MeanFlow 蒸馏方法，同时将转换过程分解为早期和晚期阶段，由专门的紧凑型阶段专家分别处理。

paragraphs.en: PVD uses the compute more effectively than the shared-model alternative: its compact phase-specific experts achieve substantially higher generation quality than repeatedly querying a shared MeanFlow backbone, while requiring only about one full-backbone evaluation in cumulative computation.
paragraphs.zh: PVD 比共享模型方案能更有效地利用计算资源：其紧凑的特定阶段专家模型在生成质量上显著优于反复查询共享的 MeanFlow 主干模型，而累计计算量仅需约一次完整主干模型的评估。

paragraphs.en: We then separate the effect of the compact phase-wise cascade from additional computation and adversarial supervision. For the full-size control, all other training settings are kept identical to those of the phase experts; the only differences are that the student retains the full backbone capacity and is optimized over [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] instead of a phase-specific sub-interval.

paragraphs.en: We see that the default PVD reaches 0.6948 GenEval score at 6.93 TFLOPs and 2.67 GiB peak VRAM. paragraphs.en: It can be concluded that our PVD design is more than a two-call compact cascade: its advantage comes from assigning dedicated experts to complementary trajectory phases in a natural early-to-late order. Reusing one expert or reversing this order consistently weakens generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 由此可以得出结论，我们的 PVD 设计不仅仅是一种两调用紧凑级联结构：其优势在于按照自然的“早-晚”顺序，为互补的轨迹阶段分配了专门的智能体。 重复使用同一个智能体或持续逆转这一顺序，都会削弱生成质量。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present failure cases of PVD regarding T2I generation. The failures highlight the limitations of current generative models in adhering to precise instructions, even when the generated content appears coherent and realistic.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们展示了 PVD 在 T2I 生成方面的失败案例。 这些失败案例凸显了当前生成模型在遵循精确指令方面的局限性，即使生成的内容看起来连贯且真实。

paragraphs.en: Positive Impacts. By cutting inference cost and halving VRAM consumption, PVD lowers the barrier to accessing state-of-the-art generative AI. Such exceptional efficiency enables deployment on consumer-grade edge devices, substantially reducing energy consumption and empowering a variety of real-time interactive applications.
paragraphs.zh: 积极影响。 通过降低推理成本并将 VRAM 消耗减半，PVD 降低了使用顶尖生成式人工智能的门槛。 这种卓越的效率使其能够在消费级边缘设备上部署，从而大幅减少能源消耗，并为各种实时交互应用提供支持。

paragraphs.en: Negative Impacts and Mitigations. Conversely, the unprecedented speed and low cost of synthesizing photorealistic images may increase the risks of generating deepfakes and misinformation. To mitigate these risks, we advocate for responsible deployment, including the mandatory integration of watermarking for traceability and safety content filters into the generation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 负面影响与缓解措施。 相反，生成照片级真实图像的空前速度和低成本可能会增加生成深度伪造和虚假信息的风险。 为缓解这些风险，我们倡导负责任地部署，包括在生成流程中强制集成水印技术以实现可追溯性，以及使用安全内容过滤器。
